description: On Windows, the app's own page may ask whether the WSL setup of the agent sandbox is offered (sandbox_wsl_setup_offered) and run it (sandbox_wsl_setup), for Settings › Agent sandbox (HAL-16765). The page names nothing: the shell starts the halonic-agent-host.exe beside the app once with --wsl-setup, the profile folder, the halonic-wsl.tar.gz image beside the app and the app itself as the command that resumes the setup after a restart, waits at most five minutes, and then starts the host in the new distro. It is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets none of it.
